note: Sixteen original showcase programs for the TNC 426/430 simulator. Educational examples for the simulator, not verified on a real control.
toolTable: Every tool is an entry of the simulator's built-in table (sim/engine.js TNC.TOOLS); holder ISO 50, A = 100 mm.

description.sv: Graverar KLARTEXT med raka streck i två skär och fräser en ram med rundade hörn.
description.en: Engraves KLARTEXT in single strokes in two passes and mills a frame with rounded corners.

stock.form: BLK FORM 0.1 Z / 0.2, blank top at Z+0, datum at the lower left corner

substitutions: Lettering: the control has no text cycle, so each letter is written as straight L strokes from the generator's own single-stroke glyphs.

features: 8 letters, 12 x 20 mm cells, 1.5 mm deep, 3 mm stroke
frame groove 6 mm wide, 1 mm deep, corner radius 5 on the centre line

description.sv: Tre rektangulära fickor i varandra med cykel 4, varje steg 6 mm djupare.
description.en: Three nested rectangular pockets with cycle 4, each step 6 mm deeper.

stock.form: BLK FORM 0.1 Z / 0.2, blank top at Z+0, datum at the lower left corner

techniques: pre-positioning in Z sets the cycle surface

description.sv: Rund ficka Ø70 som fräses inifrån och ut i en spiral av inkrementala polära block, två djup.
description.en: Round pocket Ø70 milled from the centre outwards along a spiral of incremental polar blocks, two depths.

stock.form: BLK FORM 0.1 Z / 0.2, blank top at Z+0, datum at the lower left corner

substitutions: Spiral: the control has no spiral interpolation; the spiral is 232 short LP blocks (IPR+0.125, IPA+10 = 4.5 mm per turn) closed by one full circle.

features: round pocket Ø70 at X+50 Y+50
floor Z-8 in two infeeds of 4 mm

description.sv: Åtta hål på en delningscirkel Ø84 (centrumborr, borr Ø8,5) och ett fräst centrumhål Ø32.
description.en: Eight holes on a Ø84 pitch circle (spot drill, Ø8.5 drill) and a milled Ø32 centre bore.

stock.form: BLK FORM 0.1 Z / 0.2, blank top at Z+0, datum at the lower left corner

features: 8 holes Ø8.5 x 16 deep on Ø84 at X+60 Y+60, first at 0 degrees

description.sv: Femuddig stjärna skriven helt med polära block (CC, LP PR/PA) inuti en ring, två skär.
description.en: Five-pointed star written entirely with polar blocks (CC, LP PR/PA) inside a ring, two passes.

stock.form: BLK FORM 0.1 Z / 0.2, blank top at Z+0, datum at the lower left corner

features: star: tips PR 42 at PA 90 + n x 72, notches PR 17

description.sv: Planfräst platta 108 x 68 med hörnradie 12, konturfräst med radiekompensering, och fyra hål.
description.en: Faced plate 108 x 68 with corner radius 12, contour-milled with radius compensation, and four holes.

stock.form: BLK FORM 0.1 Z / 0.2, blank top at Z+0, datum at the lower left corner

features: outline 108 x 68, corner radius 12, wall to Z-8.5
4 holes Ø8.5 to Z-12.5 at 20 mm from the plate corners

description.sv: Hål Ø40 x 18 fräst med skruvlinje (CP med IZ) i två radier, och en försänkning Ø56 x 4.
description.en: Bore Ø40 x 18 milled with helical interpolation (CP with IZ) at two radii, plus a Ø56 x 4 counterbore.

stock.form: BLK FORM 0.1 Z / 0.2, blank top at Z+0, datum at the lower left corner

substitutions: Bore: written as explicit CP helix blocks instead of cycle 208, to show the helix itself (04_BOLT_CIRCLE uses cycle 208).

features: bore Ø40 to Z-18 at X+40 Y+40

description.sv: SL-cykler: ficka med rundade hörn och två öar (rund och romb), grovfräst, sedan botten och sida finfräst.
description.en: SL cycles: a pocket with rounded corners and two islands (round and diamond), roughed out, then floor and side finished.

stock.form: BLK FORM 0.1 Z / 0.2, blank top at Z+0, datum at the lower left corner

techniques: subcontours as LBL, RR pocket / RL island

features: pocket X+8..92 Y+15..85, corner radius 10, floor Z-8
round island Ø18 at X+35 Y+50
diamond island 18 across at X+68 Y+50

description.sv: Kugghjulsliknande kontur med 12 raka kuggar i polära block. En visuell demonstration, inte ett certifierat evolventkugghjul.
description.en: Gear-like outline with 12 straight-flanked teeth in polar blocks. A visual demonstration, not a certified involute gear.

stock.form: BLK FORM 0.1 Z / 0.2, blank top at Z+0, datum at the lower left corner

substitutions: Tooth form: straight flanks between a root circle (PR 38) and a tip circle (PR 48) instead of involute flanks; the control has no gear cycle and the engine no FK. Not a certified involute gear.

features: 12 teeth, tip Ø96, root Ø76, 6 mm high

description.sv: Planfräsning med cykel 230 och ett slingrande spår med kulfräs och tangentiella bågar, allt med kylvätska (M8).
description.en: Face milling with cycle 230 and a serpentine groove with a ball cutter and tangential arcs, all under coolant (M8).

stock.form: BLK FORM 0.1 Z / 0.2, blank top at Z+0, datum at the lower left corner

substitutions: Coolant: M8 / M9 switch the simulator's coolant spray; there is no fluid model, so the sweep is the tool path under coolant.

features: serpentine groove, ball Ø6, 3 mm below the faced top, three runs joined by R10 arcs

description.sv: Tre rosetter räknade med Q-parametrar: radie = Q4 + Q5 x cos(6 x vinkel), med hopp och underprogram.
description.en: Three rosettes computed with Q parameters: radius = Q4 + Q5 x cos(6 x angle), with jumps and a subprogram.

stock.form: BLK FORM 0.1 Z / 0.2, blank top at Z+0, datum at the lower left corner

features: 6 lobes each, 3 degree steps, 1 mm deep, 3 mm stroke

description.sv: Ett underprogram (rund ficka Ø16) anropas 15 gånger i ett 5 x 3-rutnät med nollpunktsförskjutning (cykel 7).
description.en: One subprogram (round pocket Ø16) is called 15 times on a 5 x 3 grid with datum shift (cycle 7).

stock.form: BLK FORM 0.1 Z / 0.2, blank top at Z+0, datum at the lower left corner

techniques: CYCL DEF 7 DATUM SHIFT with Q

description.sv: Samma kvadrat 40 x 40 körs tre gånger: RR (utanför), R0 (på linjen) och RL (innanför). Resultatet är en trappa som visar förskjutningen.
description.en: The same 40 x 40 square is run three times: RR (outside), R0 (on the line) and RL (inside). The result is a staircase that shows the offset.

stock.form: BLK FORM 0.1 Z / 0.2, blank top at Z+0, datum at the lower left corner

techniques: compensation switched on and off in L blocks
substitutions: Approach: each compensated pass plunges on its own offset path and switches RL / RR on in the first L block, so no lead-in mark is left; APPR / DEP are shown in 06, 09 and 16.

features: RR pass: band 6 mm outside the line at Z-6
R0 pass: band 3 mm each side at Z-4
RL pass: band 6 mm inside the line at Z-2

description.sv: Sju verktyg i en körning: planfräs, grovficka, finficka, centrumborr, borr, gängtapp M10 och fasfräs.
description.en: Seven tools in one run: face mill, pocket roughing, pocket finishing, spot drill, drill, M10 tap and chamfer mill.

stock.form: BLK FORM 0.1 Z / 0.2, blank top at Z+0, datum at the lower left corner

features: pocket 72 x 42, corner radius 6, floor Z-8.5
4 holes Ø8.5 to Z-18.5 at X+12/108 Y+12/68, tapped M10 x 1.5 to Z-14.5

description.sv: Endast TNC 430: cykel 304 vrider B-huvudet 30 grader och cykel 19 lutar bearbetningsplanet lika mycket, en sned yta fräses och två hål borras vinkelrätt mot den.
description.en: TNC 430 only: cycle 304 turns the B head 30 degrees and cycle 19 tilts the working plane to match, a sloped face is milled and two holes are drilled square to it.

stock.form: BLK FORM 0.1 Z / 0.2, blank top at Z+0, datum at the lower left corner

techniques: CYCL DEF 304 B head (machine builder, placeholder H1)
CYCL DEF 200 DRILLING in the tilted plane
substitutions: Radius compensation in the tilted plane is approximate in the engine (docs/FEATURES.txt), so the sloped face is milled with R0 centre-line passes.

features: face sloped 30 degrees about Y along the X+100 edge, from X+65.4 on the top to Z-20 on the side
2 holes Ø8.5 x 12 square to the sloped face, 40 mm apart

description.sv: Ett lekfullt verkstadsmärke: rundad bricka, stora siffror 5511, tunn ram, två polära stjärnor och fyra nitmärken.
description.en: A playful shop badge: rounded plate, big 5511 numerals, a thin frame, two polar stars and four rivet marks.

stock.form: BLK FORM 0.1 Z / 0.2, blank top at Z+0, datum at the lower left corner

substitutions: Numerals: written as straight L strokes from the generator's own single-stroke glyphs (no text cycle on the control).
"5511" is treated as a shop badge text only; it stands for no part number, standard or certification.

features: badge outline 150 x 100, corner radius 15, wall to Z-4
numerals 5511: 22 x 40 mm cells, 6 mm stroke, 3 mm deep
